entry_points.text: Boot builds per-zone caches and first percpu chunk; arrival refreshes thresholds, departure drains reclaim and cache.
Sysctl exposes watermarks and NUMA order bounded; idle read reports still-idle frames, write clears refs, misaligned rejected.
Hotplug builds ext on online, tears down on offline; contig rejects compound; poison uses boot flag; reporting registers one sweeper.
Swap write completes vectors ending writeback; owner debugfs offers open, release, write and seek with seq iteration over stacks.
Shrink discards empty slabs, shutdown flushes and reports survivors; sheaf batches deferred frees for RCU workers.
Large uses frozen pages, nolock uses trylock with one retry; sensitive free clears; sysinfo reports system or node totals.

exports.text: Bulk fills array, frozen leaves pages untracked, node defaults to running node with offline check, folio builds compound groups.
Free validates and releases single, exact-sized or range frames; contig isolates, drains, migrates and extracts aligned blocks.
Buddy take splits around target, put returns at zero ref; ext maps frame to record with hold; rmap walk reports each mapping.
Swap activates ordered extents with merge checks and submits IO; compressed load validates; object read spans one or two segments.
Owner stores alloc stack and clears on free; poison patterns freed pages; table check hooks clear and install at all levels.
Percpu validates, searches, creates and populates with rollback and zeroing; helpers test membership and translate to physical.
Cache create reuses compatible entries with validation, destroy drains and releases empty ones; buckets cover sizes.
Barriers drain deferred and RCU work before teardown; RCU free uses sheaf, sync or batched paths; size resolves usable length.

hazards.text: Bulk with single remainder yields at most one page; unlocked buddy probe advisory; walk resamples treating splits as leaf.
Misaligned swap errors; owner reads racy with dummy stacks; poison singles rate-limited, table mishandling fatal.
Shortfalls fail clean freeing partials; failures warn rate-limited with blocking-only stacks flagging atomic exhaustion.
Destroy with live objects warns yet unlinks; bad size or placement traps; headless free needs sleepable context, realtime bypasses sheaf.

invariants.text: Oversize orders rejected; contig needs online same-zone movable frames with last frame in zone; free splits toward target.
Exact rounds to power of two returning tail; reserved clears tags growing total; clean takes file folios only.
Null or flagged ext means absent; lookup scales node-relative frame by runtime size; teardown is idempotent adjusting census.
Frag refill prefers large tolerant page; idle samples only online reclaim-list heads; rmap matches on span overlap migration-aware.
Tunable writes parse bounded then rebuild watermarks and reserves; zonelist accepts only leading letters; cache flag follows share.
Extents stay gapless ordered else fatal; zero runs bounded by cluster; read accounts success only, always unlocks and recycles.
Owner updates all tails, links stacks warning on underflow, skips buddy blocks by order, validates and clamps scans.
Alloc scans for pattern deviations; reporting isolates above minimum without coalescing; table keeps anon and file exclusive.
Search uses hints over aligned runs, atomics on backed only; empty pages kept between marks; first chunk automatic.
Shrinker ids grow in multiples with RCU publish, allocated to drained; available is free minus reserves plus discounted reclaimable.
Merge needs matching flags and close size unless suppressed; object index from stride; RCU reclaims after grace with monitor delay.

locks.text: Bulk trial-takes pcp cache nonblocking releasing before fallback; buddy take scoped; contig holds zone lock dropping across sleep.
Retention under pcp lock, fraction reads lockless; ext acquire holds read guard; walk holds per-level locks dropping across tables.
IO under read sections; stack list under IRQ-save spin with task flag; reporting drops zone lock for callbacks, lifetime under mutex.
Percpu spin guards metadata and slots; alloc mutex serializes creation never atomic; shrinker mutex serializes ids with RCU free.
Slab mutex serializes create, alias and destroy; flush needs CPU read lock and flush mutex; RCU detach uses raw spin with exchange.

state_machines.text: Bulk skips remote zones testing reserves then takes entries; contig validates, isolates, migrates, verifies, extracts then unisolates.
Clean selects and splices survivors; ext online inits with rollback, offline invalidates; frag aligns or recycles; walk descends to match.
Swap prefers zero then compressed then queued IO; owner sets on alloc clears on free; reporting idles then reschedules; free patterns.
Chunk goes descriptor to backing to linked then release; chunks move among size, free and sidelined lists; background cycles reclaim.
Slab moves down to partial to up to full; barrier offloads then drains; free discards slabs reordering partials; monitor drains and rearms.

structs.text: Alloc context carries zonelist, mask and migratetype; flags encode watermarks, reserves, nolock and compaction behavior.
Frag handle packs aligned address with order and reserve bits; idle bitmap unit is one word with aligned positions.
Owner holds order, handles and pid with limited stacks; table check has anon and file counters; reporting has order and delay.
Block tracks edge free and largest runs; chunk aggregates links, maps, hints and tallies; extension carries group and tag.
Slot shift and threshold bound placement, empty marks bound backing, shrink batch sizes scans, slab flags encode nolock.
Freelist has head, counts and frozen flag; cache holds sizing, policy and constructor; snapshot captures occupancy and tuning.
Bulk has grace and payload, per-CPU has queues and monitor; core and debug flag sets gate merge and presentation.
